chains.title: The ref T allele preserves an ARID5B repressor site that the alt C disrupts; de-repression of the FTO intron-1 enhancer raises IRX3/IRX5 in adipocyte progenitors and shifts them from beige to white fat
chains.element: dELS enhancer EH38E3181208 (chr16:53766999-53767220) in FTO intron 1

links.claim: ARID5B is predicted to bind the conserved ref T allele more strongly and to lose binding on alt C. A qbic_tf_detail lookup shows ARID5B is not_in_coverage in QBiC-SELEX, so no QBiC z-score or direction can be cited for it, and no other group's binding change is used as a proxy for ARID5B. The only supporting evidence here is modest conservation at the site (GERP 2.55); the direction rests on prior literature on this locus, not on evidence in this dossier.

The variant lies inside a distal enhancer-like cCRE (EH38E3181208). The DNase/H3K27ac z-scores quoted in SCREEN belong to the neighbouring cCRE EH38E3181207 and are maxima across biosamples, so adipose-progenitor activity of the variant's own element is not demonstrated here.

The proposed target is IRX3 (520 kb away), acting by long-range contact rather than on FTO itself. This dossier gives no support for IRX3: L2G scores FTO 0.99 and gives IRX3 nothing, and there are no molecular QTLs; the absence of any adipose eQTL for FTO at this variant is at least consistent with the effect not being a simple local FTO eQTL.
The expression context scored is bulk GTEx subcutaneous adipose used as a preadipocyte proxy; nothing here shows progenitor-specific activity, and ARID5B expression was not retrieved.

The variant has an extremely strong, T-risk-allele obesity/BMI association with secondary T2D and HbA1c signals; a progenitor beige-to-white shift is one mechanism compatible with that, but is not evidenced here.

ESRRA is chosen within the group only because it is the sole well-expressed member in subcutaneous adipose (34.08 TPM, own model) while ESRRG/ESRRB are near zero; ESRRA's own z (17.39) is the lowest of the passing members, so the TF choice is expression-based and weak.
The variant sits in a dELS cCRE; the SCREEN activity numbers are for the adjacent cCRE and are cross-biosample maxima, so adipose activity of this element is not shown.

FTO is the top L2G gene for credible sets containing this variant (0.99), but L2G is a locus-level score and does not show that this enhancer regulates FTO; no adipose eQTL for FTO is detected at this variant.
ESRRA is expressed in bulk subcutaneous adipose (34.08 TPM); occupancy in preadipocytes is not demonstrated.
Altered FTO dosage in adipose could change energy balance, matching the strong BMI/obesity association; no evidence here connects FTO expression to the phenotype.

links.claim: QBiC group G008 (TALE homeodomain) predicts the largest consistent alt gain among expressed groups (best model PKNOX2, z 54.71, effect +3.047; 9/9 models same sign; 95.5th to 99.7th percentile). The group names a shared specificity, not one TF; TGIF1 is chosen as the most expressed covered member in adipose (13.07 TPM, own model) with TGIF2 (11.62 TPM, z 42.72) a close alternative. TGIF1's own z and sign are not shown in the group row, so the within-group assignment remains uncertain.
The gained site lies in a dELS cCRE; adipose-specific activity of this element is not established by the SCREEN maxima cited.

TGIF proteins are TGF-beta pathway corepressors, so gained binding would be expected to damp this element rather than activate it; the long-range target is proposed to be IRX3/IRX5, which has no L2G or eQTL support here (L2G favours FTO; no adipose eQTL at this variant).
TALE factors (TGIF1/2, MEIS1/2/3, PKNOX1) are all expressed in subcutaneous adipose, so the context is plausible; no preadipocyte-specific data are cited.
A change in progenitor enhancer output could alter fat storage and body mass, consistent with the BMI/obesity association.

E04 and E06c support the SNP-obesity association, but nothing links altered FTO expression or m6A control to it. The activating direction is asserted without evidence.

G008 shows a large alt gain, with 9/9 models agreeing. TGIF1 has its own model and 13 TPM, but it is not a passing member listed by name. The best model is PKNOX2, and TGIF2, MEIS3 and others rank higher. TGIF1 was picked on expression alone, and its z and direction should be looked up with qbic_tf_detail.

E07 is a screen header for bulk subcutaneous adipose. It shows nothing about adipocyte progenitors, and ARID5B expression was not retrieved.

E04, E06b, E06c and E06e support the T-allele BMI/obesity association strongly. They do not show a beige-to-white shift, an ARID5B mechanism or IRX3 involvement, so the phenotype link to this chain is only indirect.

G037 predicts alt gain with consistent sign (E08), and ESRRA has its own model at 34.08 TPM, which is a reasonable expression-based pick. But ESRRA's own z (17.39) is the lowest of the group and this is only an in-vitro binding prediction. The activating effect is not shown.
E03 shows only a dELS cCRE classification. The activity numbers are from the neighbouring cCRE and are cross-biosample maxima, so activity of this element in adipose is not shown.

L2G 0.99 for FTO (E05) is a locus-level genetic score, and genetics ranks above context. It does not show that this enhancer regulates FTO, and E19 shows no adipose eQTL. An FTO target is therefore only weakly supported.
E08 shows ESRRA at 34.08 TPM in bulk subcutaneous adipose. Preadipocyte occupancy is not shown. The evidence is expression context only.

G008 predicts a large, consistent alt gain (E09), and TGIF1 is a covered, expressed member with its own model. But TGIF1's own z and sign are not shown, and the TF is chosen by expression within a group. This is a prediction only, and a qbic_tf_detail lookup for TGIF1 is needed.
E03 shows only a dELS classification. Activity is from the neighbouring cCRE and is a cross-biosample maximum, so adipose activity of this element is not shown.
Neither E02 nor E05 supports IRX3. L2G favours FTO and E19 shows no adipose eQTL. The repressor role of TGIF is asserted from outside knowledge, not from cited evidence.

G002 predicts alt gain (E10), but members disagree on direction and PPARG's own z and sign are not shown. Choosing PPARG on expression is weak. E20 shows no PPARG ChIP peak at or near the variant, which counts against occupancy. A qbic_tf_detail lookup for PPARG would settle direction.

L2G 0.99 for FTO (E05) is locus-level genetic support. It does not link this enhancer to FTO, and E19 shows no adipose eQTL.

next_experiment: Run an allelic luciferase reporter / small MPRA of the 200 bp EH38E3181208 element (T vs C, both orientations) in human subcutaneous preadipocytes. It is the cheapest assay that distinguishes the top two chains: H1 predicts a reproducible allelic activity difference (C more active, repressor lost), while H5 (null) predicts no difference; a positive result also sets the direction needed to adjudicate H2/H3.
